case_name: Dr. Fazal Ghafoor v Union of India and Others
facts: The Petitioner has asked for five reliefs: ...
In this application under Article 32 of the Constitution of India, 1950...
The Presidential Order or the constitutional provision authorising the issuance of such order is hit by violation of the basic structure of the Constitution.
This Court has observed that in Super Specialities there should really be no reservation.
We hope and trust that the Government of India and the State Governments shall seriously consider this aspect of the matter...
petitioner_arguments: There is no merit in the allegation that the Presidential Order or the constitutional provision authorising the issuance of such order is hit by violation of the basic structure of the Constitution.
In Super Specialities there should really be no reservation.
court_reasoning: This Court has observed that in Super Specialities there should really be no reservation.
We hope and trust that the Government of India and the State Governments shall seriously consider this aspect of the matter...
holding: A declaration that all the Post Doctoral seats (Super Specialities) in all the universities and States of India including the All India Medical Institute should not have any regional or domicile reservations and should be open for All India Competition on merit;
The writ petition is disposed of. There would be no order for costs.
cases_cited: By our judgment delivered today in Dr. C. Surekha V. Union of India
